tools.name: search_docstar_docs
tools.description: Search DocStar's documentation and guides with a natural-language question, e.g. "how do I add a custom domain to my docs?" or "how does sign-in work on my MCP server?". Returns the most relevant passages with their page URLs. Use it for how-to and concept questions about DocStar. To find an API end

tools.name: get_docstar_api_docs
tools.description: Browse the DocStar API reference one level at a time, when no dedicated tool on this server does what the user needs. Call it with {} for the top level: the modules (Collections, Pages, Endpoints, Published Versions, MCP Server, FAQs, Changelogs, Webhooks, URL Mappings, ...) with a short description

tools.name: call_any_api_of_docstar
tools.description: Send a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request to any DocStar API endpoint for the signed-in user and return { status, ok, headers, data }. Use it for changes no dedicated tool covers, once you know the exact endpoint: from the quickstart-docstar skill's recipes, or looked up with get_docstar_api_docs. F

tools.name: call_any_read_api_of_docstar
tools.description: Read from any DocStar API endpoint with a GET request for the signed-in user and return { status, ok, headers, data }. Use it for lookups no dedicated tool covers, once you know the exact endpoint: from the quickstart-docstar skill's recipes, or looked up with get_docstar_api_docs. Never guess a URL

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.description: List the DocStar organizations (workspaces) the signed-in user belongs to, with each one's id and name (the list is at data.data). Start every DocStar task here: show the user the organizations and ask which one to use, unless there is only one. The chosen id is the orgId every other DocStar tool ne

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the collections (docs sites) in an organization, with each one's id, name, type and the caller's permission (1 read, 2 read-write). Each collection also has rootParentId: the parent pageId to use with create_page for a top-level page. Get orgId from list_organizations. Pass exclude=runCollectio

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Get a collection's MCP server: the url end users connect to, ready-to-paste snippets (a Claude Code command and a JSON config), callbackUrls for the OAuth app, the sign-in setup and any custom domain. Creates the server if it's missing and syncs its tools with the published endpoints. Call it after

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Creates a new documentation collection in the organization together with its invisible root page (type 0), auto-assigns collection permissions to all org users based on their roles, and auto-provisions an MCP server for it in the background. The returned rootParentId is the page id under which top-l

tools.name: create_endpoint
tools.description:
Creates a new API endpoint doc (page type 4, draft) as the last child of the given page. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Publish it afterwards with Update Endpoint State (parent page must be published).
Body fields:

name (string, optional) - Endpoint title shown in docs.
urlName (string, optional)

tools.name: update_endpoint
tools.description: Partially updates an API endpoint doc; send only fields to change (same fields as Create Endpoint). Any update moves a non-pending endpoint back to draft (state 1), so republish with Update Endpoint State. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Only works for type 4/5 items (otherwise 400 "Wrong Route"). I

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Creates a new page as the last child of the page given in the path. Pass the collection's rootParentId (invisible root, from List Collections) to create a top-level page (type 1, parent page/module); pass any other page id to create a subpage (type 3). The type is decided by the parent, not the body

tools.name: publish_pages
tools.description: Publishes many pages/endpoints at once: each page in pageIds gets a new default published version and state 2 (approved/published). rootParentId (the collection's invisible root page) must also be supplied so it is marked published. Requires READ_WRITE permission. Triggers background search indexing

tools.name: list_collection_pages
tools.description: Returns all non-deleted pages of a collection (the full sidebar tree, flat) with id, name, urlName, type, parentId, child (ordered child ids), state, isPublished, meta, sharingMeta and the endpoint requestType for endpoint pages. Page types: 0 invisible root, 1 parent page/module (top-level), 3 subp

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_docstar_docs, get_docstar_api_docs, call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, get_mcp_server, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, create_page · Private data: get_docstar_api_docs, call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, send_feedback_to_docstar · Public sink: call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, create_page, publish_pages, send_feedback_to_docstar · Destructive: call_any_api_of_docstar, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_docstar_docs, get_docstar_api_docs, call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, get_mcp_server, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, create_page · Private data: get_docstar_api_docs, call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, send_feedback_to_docstar · Public sink: call_any_api_of_docstar, call_any_read_api_of_docstar, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint, create_page, publish_pages, send_feedback_to_docstar · Destructive: call_any_api_of_docstar, create_collection, create_endpoint, update_endpoint

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
